Title: Azure Monitor for Containers: Enhanced search on live data and other updates available

Body.Content:
• Live data now provides pull down pills filter on the event logs to show only pod, namespace, node, or cluster Kubernetes event.
  • Search has enhanced on live data so you can find the next keyword.
  • Kubelet health and node network performance is now available thru workbook.
  • Filter is now available for data collection via agent. You can filter data collection per namespace for environmental variable, container log stdout and stderr. Detailed Release Note is here. 

For more information, please see the documentation.
